starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
 seen=set(); comps=[]
 for r in range(H):
  for c in range(W):
   if g[r][c]==3 and (r,c) not in seen:
    q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
    while q:
     y,x=q.pop();cells.append((y,x))
     for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

      if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy][xx]==3 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
       seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
    comps.append(cells)

  rs=[p[0] for p in cells];cs=[p[1] for p in cells]; r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs);c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
  colors=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if g[r][c] not in (3,8)]

     g[y][x]=color;y+=dr;x+=dc
